findings.description: Every finding of the review, as pack-review's steps 1 to 5 sort them.

inline.description: Whether the finding gets a comment on the PR: true for every deviation and conflict, and for an uncovered choice that adds a second way beside an existing one. Others wait for the author's local run.

rules.description: The rule a deviation departs from, the two rules of a conflict, or none for an uncovered choice.

file.description: The file holding the rule, from the repo root.

routed.description: Whether the rule reached the work: inlined, or in a doc whose when matches it.

spots.description: Where in the head commit the finding applies.

line.description: The line in the file at the head commit.

follows.description: Whether the spot follows the rule. Always false for an uncovered choice.

deliberate.description: Signs a deviation is deliberate, each quoting its source: a comment at the spot, a condition that sets it apart, the PR description, a commit message, or a comment on the PR.

exemplars.description: For an uncovered choice, each way the existing code makes it.

items.description: A file and line, as path:line.

take.description: What you'd do about it, for the author to accept or overrule.

threads.description: What to do on the PR's review threads, given the threads you started earlier: open one for an inline finding that has none, reply where a finding changed or a person asked something, and resolve one whose finding is gone. Act only on threads marked pack_review.

thread.description: For reply and resolve: the thread's id.

path.description: For new: the file to comment on.

line.description: For new: the line at the head commit, which must be in the diff.

body.description: The comment, in Markdown. For resolve, the closing note saying why.
